001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.CommodityOnMarketAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.listeners.EconomyTickListener;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.econ.RecentUnrest;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Commodities;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
010
011public class SDFuelShortage implements EconomyTickListener {
012        
013        public static String KEY = "$sindrianDiktatFuelShortage_ref";
014        public static SDFuelShortage get() {
015                return (SDFuelShortage) Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(KEY);
016        }
017        
018        public static void end() {
019                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().removeListener(get());
020                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(KEY);
021        }
022        
023        
024        protected boolean firstTime = true;
025        
026        public SDFuelShortage() {
027                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().addListener(this);
028                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KEY, this);
029                
030                reportEconomyTick(0);
031        }
032
033        public void reportEconomyTick(int iterIndex) {
034                String fuelShortageId = "SDFuelShortage";
035                for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
036                        if (Factions.DIKTAT.equals(market.getFactionId())) continue;
037                        if (Factions.DIKTAT_ACHILLES.equals(market.getFactionId())) continue;
038                        
039                        int penalty = 1;
040                        if (market.getSize() >= 5) penalty = 2;
041                        CommodityOnMarketAPI fuel = market.getCommodityData(Commodities.FUEL);
042                        fuel.getAvailableStat().addTemporaryModFlat(
043                                        10f,
044                                        fuelShortageId, "Sindrian Diktat civil war", -penalty);
045                        
046                        if (firstTime) {
047                                RecentUnrest.get(market).add(1, "Outbreak of civil war in the Sindrian Diktat");
048                        }
049                }
050                firstTime = false;
051        }
052
053        @Override
054        public void reportEconomyMonthEnd() {
055                
056        }
057        
058}
